column3: requireInviterActive (invitations.go, #4507) is requireActorActive on the inviter: it reads only the inviter's own account row, not state of the membership or role rows the grants write, so it is an actor-authority check. A stale pass equals accept-then-suspend: suspension takes effect on the inviter's next request and does not undo past grants, a legal serial order; the check only narrows what accept allowed before #4507 (it is also made before the account is created, in completeInvitationAccept), so it adds no race window. Covers this check only.
